## What Tanish Anand Does

Tanish Anand is a builder and researcher working at the intersection of AI, hardware, and the web. He is the founder of CareLink, a care coordination platform for aging parents in tier-2 Indian cities, and the developer of Project Rudra, a GPU-accelerated global OSINT command grid.

He is currently a Research Fellow at IIT Kanpur under Prof. Adithya Vadapalli, benchmarking discrete text diffusion architectures (SEDD, LLaDA) against auto-regressive LLMs on Hindi NLP pipelines.

## Projects

### CareLink (2026, Active)
Care coordination platform for aging parents in tier-2 Indian cities. Uses WhatsApp + Google Sheets, zero-code MVP.

### Project Rudra (2026, Completed)
GPU-accelerated global OSINT command grid. Integrates real-time flight tracking, marine channels, active CCTV networks, seismic activity, and live global broadcasts in a 60fps WebGL interface.
- Live: https://osirisai.live

### Text Diffusion vs. AR Models (2026, Research)
Research project benchmarking discrete and continuous text diffusion architectures (SEDD, LLaDA) against auto-regressive LLMs on Hindi NLP pipelines.

### EduCore (2025)
Solar-powered offline adaptive AI learning device for rural Indian students. Runs quantized Phi-3 Mini locally on a Raspberry Pi.

### PhysicsGPT (2025)
Offline AI tutor fine-tuned on CBSE Physics curriculum, deployable on edge hardware.

### ComplianceGuard (2025, Completed)
Dual-LLM autonomous compliance agent. Grok handles fast scanning, Claude performs deep audit reasoning for SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001.

### Anti-Sleep Pilot (2026, Hackathon)
Real-time drowsiness detection system using computer vision. Built and pitched at HACKSHODH 2026.

## Security Advisories

### ADV-2026-001 — Prompt Injection Sandbox Escape (CRITICAL 9.8) — RESOLVED
Identified a prompt injection flaw bypassing the host executor sandbox on an AI inference platform. Allowed escaping localized Python runtime cages and accessing private environment tokens.

### ADV-2025-004 — Cart Valuation Logic Bypass (HIGH 8.4) — RESOLVED
Discovered a state mutation flow where cart totals could be arbitrarily manipulated by injecting negative float values into secondary item arrays on a quick-commerce checkout API.

### ADV-2025-002 — OpenCV Frame Skip Bypass (MEDIUM 6.1) — PATCHED
Bypassed face boundary state tracker metrics by injecting rapid sequence frames which crashed sleep detection algorithms.
